pages.text: $(italic)Dragon-blooded and ancient. Resilient and imposing, the Ryu shrugs off damage and heals from food.$()$(br2)$(bold)Dragon Scales$(): $(item)25% less damage$() from every source, and +4 max HP.$(br2)$(bold)Slow Fall$(): broken wings give slow fall, not true flight.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Draconic Vitality$(): while your food bar is at 18 or more, you heal 1 health every 2 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon's Sight$(): make every nearby creature glow (15s cooldown).$(br2)Poison, Slowness and Weakness wear off you within seconds (one of the three is cleared every second).

pages.title: Tradeoffs
pages.text: $(bold)Meat Preference$(): $(warn)non-meat food gives less nourishment.$()$(br2)$(bold)Potion Resistance$(): $(warn)while Regeneration is on you, every heal is halved$(), your own included. Without it, potions heal in full.$(br2)$(bold)Next: skip Regeneration and eat well. Your healing runs through your stomach.$()
